betterlight.options.smoothFluids.tooltip: Smooth light on water and lava instead of one light value per block face.
betterlight.options.smoothNoAoModels.too: Smooth light without ambient occlusion darkening for rails, plants and other models with AO turned off (MC-231102).
betterlight.options.smoothEmitters.toolt: Smooth light on light-emitting blocks such as the nether portal (MC-1531).
betterlight.options.blockEntityLightFiel: Per-vertex light on chests, signs and other block entities instead of one value per block.
betterlight.options.smoothEntities.toolt: Interpolated light on entities, so they don't jump when crossing a light edge.
betterlight.options.smoothPaintingsFrame: Per-corner smooth light on paintings and item frames (MC-1531).
betterlight.options.movingBlockAo.toolti: Falling blocks (sand, gravel...) and blocks pushed by pistons keep their ambient occlusion while they move.
betterlight.options.movingBlockShadows.t: Falling blocks and blocks pushed by pistons darken the terrain around them like placed blocks do. Remeshes nearby chunk sections as blocks fall.
betterlight.options.extendedPistonAo.too: Extended piston bases darken the terrain around them like retracted pistons do, instead of casting no ambient occlusion.
betterlight.options.frontEmitters.toolti: Lit furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces and jack o'lanterns (tag betterlight:front_emitters) only light what they can see in front of them. Light already stored by the world updates when those chunks are relit.
betterlight.options.directionalTorches.t: Torches, lanterns, campfires, glowstone and other light sources (tag betterlight:shadowed_emitters) fully light only what they can see; light escaping through a gap or around a corner fades quickly.
